user.title: Connect to your mempool instance
user.description: Enter the base URL of your mempool web server — your own self-hosted node, or a public instance.

data_description.base_url: Include the scheme, host and port. If it is behind a reverse proxy, enter the proxy's address.
data_description.verify_ssl: Turn off for an HTTPS instance with a self-signed certificate.
data_description.fast_interval: How often to poll fast-changing data (chain tip, fees, mempool). Poll public instances gently.

currency.title: Price currency

import_price_history.description: Backfill Home Assistant long-term statistics for the price sensor from the node's historical-price feed, so price charts are rich immediately.
